title: Chapter 64 Eastern Spirit
content:
Chapter 64 Eastern Spirit

What surprised Wang Shuo was that until the system prompt sounded, the crocodile lizard did not launch any threatening counterattack.

[You killed the 15 bronze boss crocodile lizard, ID: Crocodile 32157 Laxi, and the reward is all attributes +1. ]

[Your level has been raised to level 11. ]

Wang Shuo noticed that the people in his team had basically been promoted by one level.

Including the ordinary crocodile lizards killed before, the three brothers Li Jianguo even raised 3 levels in a row, reaching level 5.

Next to the boss, there were some exploded equipment scattered around.

[Kiss of Fangs +1, Soul Crystal +1, Energy Crystal +30. ]

This Kiss of Fangs is a gold-level dagger with paralysis effect.

The attack power is as high as 80, which makes Guliji jealous.

Among the people present, she is the only one who is most suitable for this equipment.

Wang Shuo looked at her eager eyes and asked with a smile: "Do you want it?"

"Yes!" Guliji nodded without hiding her inner expectation.

Wang Shuo pulled out the dagger, and saw a cold light emitting from it, which made people shudder!

He put the blade close to the back of his hand, and a feeling of electric shock instantly spread throughout his body, and his body trembled slightly involuntarily.

He quickly took the dagger away, and after several seconds, the numbness disappeared.

"It is indeed a good dagger!" Wang Shuo couldn't help but admire it, and then looked at Guliji and said: "This dagger is left to you to use!"

After that, Wang Shuo directly inserted the dagger into the scabbard and threw it to Guliji.

"Thank you, Lord!"

After Guliji took the dagger, her heart could not calm down for a long time.

You know, a gold-quality weapon is almost equivalent to the attack power of all its attributes added together.

If she were to face the crocodile-lipped lizard again at this moment, she would be able to fight.

Wang Shuo no longer cared about Guliji, but walked towards the waterfall beside the pool.

There was also a silver treasure chest in this place that he coveted.

After entering the waterfall with Ayub and others, there was a different world inside.

Inside the waterfall was a cave, and at the entrance of the cave was a silver treasure chest, without any obstruction.

Wang Shuo walked over quickly and observed the surrounding situation.

After finding no danger, he quickly put away the treasure chest.

It was safe to put it in the bag.

Only then did he focus on the situation in the cave.

The entrance of the cave was very wide, and deep inside was a stone door.

There were several strange characters written on the door couplet, which Wang Shuo did not recognize.

There was a relief sculpture of a tiger on the stone door, but it was a little different from the tiger in Wang Shuo's meeting room.

Wang Shuo asked Chang Gui.

Chang Gui thought for a while, and then said: "This may be the legendary Bi'an."

Could it be the Bi'an who was in charge of criminal justice?

Wang Shuo was a little confused and hesitated whether to go in and take a look.

The stone door was half open, and it looked like someone had opened it, but if someone had entered, why hadn't the silver treasure chest at the door been taken away?

Wang Shuo was a little confused.

Anyway, he had Ayub and a resurrection coin, so it was not a waste at all.

After thinking about it, Wang Shuo decided to let the three Li brothers meet at the door, and the others followed him to find out.

In the passage, there was an oil lamp every ten meters, which was lit at this time, which made Wang Shuo more cautious.

Gong Zheng still held up the shield and walked in front.

After walking through the long and narrow passage, he entered a wide hall.

There were several passages leading to farther distances, and there were several cells on both sides of the passage.

This was clearly a prison.

The nearby cells were empty and there was nothing inside.

In some cells not far away, there were some bones, which seemed to be dead prisoners.

Wang Shuo observed carefully, chose a passage, and walked in, wanting to see if there was anything valuable.

A few minutes later, Wang Shuo returned the same way and found nothing.

Just as everyone returned to the hall.

Guliji frowned, pointed to a lame stool on the ground, and said to Wang Shuo: "Lord, something is wrong. When we came just now, this stool on the ground was not in this position."

Wang Shuo also took a look at the stool.

"Did any of you move it?" Wang Shuo looked at everyone and asked.

"No."

"Could it be that there are other people in this dungeon?"

Wang Shuo frowned and speculated secretly.

"Be careful and alert." He said to everyone decisively.

At the same time, he kept observing the surrounding environment, trying to find possible hidden dangers.

At this moment, a cry for help came.

"Help, is there anyone?"

In this prison, a girl's cry for help was heard.

It immediately made Wang Shuo a little creepy.

"Let's go and see." Wang Shuo bravely walked towards the passage where the call for help was made.

Soon, he came to a cell at the end.

A young girl was being held in the cell.

She was wearing a white floral dress, spotless, and didn't look like she was in prison at all.

Wang Shuo approached and saw that she was about 17 or 18 years old, with a rosy face and no nervousness.

"Silly boy, let me out quickly." The girl said in an imprisoning tone.

Wang Shuo was immediately unhappy!

He looked over with a delusion-breaking eye.

[Dongfang Ling]

【Level 17】

…

She is actually a player.

This surprised Wang Shuo. He thought she was a monster like a thousand-year-old demon imprisoned here.

Unexpectedly, she was a level 17 player, higher than himself.

"How did you get locked up here? And you know someone is outside?"

"Are you an idiot? You guys are making so much noise outside, I'm not deaf."

Although Dongfang Ling's voice is very pleasant, her words are very unpleasant.

"What are you doing? Find the key!" Dongfang Ling looked at everyone anxiously, with an expression of looking at a fool.

Baili Liang immediately moved and planned to find the key.

Wang Shuo frowned, turned to look at Baili Liang, and scolded: "Don't move."

He turned around and looked at Dongfang Ling, who was bossing around, and asked: "May I ask your name? Why are you locked up here?"

"Oh, why are you so annoying, asking questions, go find the key."

Wang Shuo looked a little unhappy.

"Well, since we don't know each other, let's say goodbye. Let's go!" Wang Shuo saw the other party's bad temper, I won't tolerate you.

Dongfang Ling was panicked when she saw this!

Yes, she used an invisibility talisman to sneak in while Wang Shuo was fighting with the crocodile lizard.

She was originally the daughter of Lord Qingyang. She was naughty by nature. When she learned that her father had sent people to the Dahuai domain to be the front station, she snatched the quota of the person selected by her father at the last moment of teleportation and teleported herself.

You know, this newly generated area is the place where the battle is the most intense, and the players inside are all enemies.

Lord Qingyang was almost angry to vomit blood when he saw his daughter teleported in.

He immediately contacted some friends and used his connections to let the people they selected protect Dongfang Ling in the battle for the village building order in the Dahuai domain.

However, Dongfang Ling didn't know this.

Her father had only one precious daughter like her, so naturally he gave her many self-defense items.

With these things, she gradually became fearless.

At the same time, she also developed a bad habit of being pampered.

Seeing that Wang Shuo was about to leave, her temper suddenly came up.

"Stop right there!" Dongfang Lingqi said angrily.

From childhood to adulthood, no one had ever dared to disobey her.
